definitions.gloss: tragedy, tragic event, disaster, horrific incident
definitions.explanation: A terrible event involving suffering, destruction, or death. Stronger and more dramatic than simply a sad event — implies horror and shock.

examples.japanese: この{惨劇|さんげき}を{二度|にど}と{繰|く}り{返|かえ}してはならない。
examples.english: We must never repeat this tragedy.

examples.japanese: {戦争|せんそう}の{惨劇|さんげき}を{語|かた}り{継|つ}ぐことが{大切|たいせつ}だ。
examples.english: It is important to pass on accounts of the tragedies of war.

notes:
USAGE:
A dramatic, literary word. Common in news reporting, historical accounts, and fiction. Not the same as {悲劇|ひげき} (tragedy in the theatrical sense or a sad event) — {惨劇|さんげき} implies gruesome or horrifying circumstances.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {惨劇|さんげき}が{起|お}きる: a tragedy occurs
- {惨劇|さんげき}を{繰|く}り{返|かえ}す: to repeat a tragedy
- {惨劇|さんげき}の{現場|げんば}: scene of a tragedy
- {惨劇|さんげき}を{語|かた}り{継|つ}ぐ: to pass on the story of a tragedy
